# Copilot instructions for this repository

- Always validate requirements before implementation.
- Prefer writing tests for the core behavior before finalizing implementation.
- Keep functions small, descriptive, and easy to read.
- Do not expose secrets or credentials in logs or code.
- Validate all file and directory inputs before processing.
- Handle missing files and empty directories gracefully.
- Document decisions and architecture changes in the docs folder.
- Prefer explicit, maintainable code over clever shortcuts.
- Review for correctness, security, and edge cases before finalizing changes.
